issues.claim: V01 §3.16's `campLand` (1) measures the reach from a built edge: the districts' union, 'or the outermost enceinte's outer strip where that lies beyond it' (l.2373–2375). §1b's row (l.283) says the same. That counts every enceinte: a castle's `bailey` curtain, and with a twin town one ring or both, left unstated. Round 3 (R3-14 (2)) made §10.2 (d) the home of the walls the crisis looks read. Those are the place's town enceintes, kinds other than `bailey`, and 'outermost' is the outer envelope of their walled arcs, the arcs of each non-nested ring that no other ring encloses. The camp places read that home, but the land they all take from is measured by the looser term. A castle stands in its own `castle` district, so the two readings move the reach by at most a strip's width. Nothing material is built differently, hence minor.
issues.required_change: V01 §3.16 `campLand` (1): '… or the outermost town enceinte's outer strip where that lies beyond it (§10.2 (d): the enceintes of kinds other than `bailey`, `outermost` the outer envelope of their walled arcs)'. V01 §1b's `campLand` row: 'the outermost town enceinte's outer strip (§10.2 (d))' for 'the outermost enceinte's outer strip'.

issues.claim: V11 §3.25.9's `disaster` look row (l.4535) reads 'share of the districts — at THORP, HAMLET and VILLAGE of V07's ends —'. §3.26's C-crisis-tables row (l.4802) reads 'at THORP, HAMLET and VILLAGE a disaster's units V07's ends'. V07 §5.6 (3), the home, and V01 §3.16 (1), rewritten this round, make the village units `villageDisasterUnits`: the ends, or in an end-less thorp its toft groups. V01 §3.16 (5) computes the share over those units, so nothing built changes. The gloss is a narrower restatement. Its siblings at V02, V03 and §10.2 (d) are VV12-r3-01, -04 and -05; V11's two sites were not raised.
issues.required_change: l.4535's cell: 'share of the districts — at THORP, HAMLET and VILLAGE of V07 §5.6 (3)'s units (its ends, or an end-less thorp's toft groups) — 0.05–0.5 at every rung; `lookLevel` 0.67–0.95'. l.4802: 'at THORP, HAMLET and VILLAGE a disaster's units V07 §5.6 (3)'s `villageDisasterUnits` (its ends, or an end-less thorp's toft groups)'.

issues.claim: §11.2's new `LooksAnswer` (R3-16 (a)) comments `crises[].districts` (l.16163) as 'a disaster look's units: V01's disasterDistricts over the model the view draws, at the village rungs V07's ends'. This is the same gloss as VAF-R3T-02. V01's `disasterDistricts` returns V07 §5.6 (3)'s units there, which in an end-less thorp are toft groups (each id its lowest plot's). The field carries what V01 returns, so nothing built changes. The comment misstates the case.
issues.required_change: l.16163: '… V01's disasterDistricts over the model the view draws, at the village rungs V07 §5.6 (3)'s units (its ends, or an end-less thorp's toft groups); key-filtered, ≤ limits.members'.
